name: Precision Food Equipment LLC.
old_description: Specializing in slicer repair, Precision Food Equipment has been servicing satisfied return customers like Arby's, Wildflower Bread Company, Claim Jumper, YC's Mongolian Grill and many more all across Arizona for years.  We are always focused on customer service satisfaction and offer a satisfaction guarantee.  We only offer services that meet the highest industry standards and our staff is fully trained and qualified.  As you may have noticed, appliances aren’t as dependable as they were in the days of our parents and grandparents but you can be sure that we can fix your appliance right the first time and get it to operate like new again!
about:
Precision Food Equipment LLC operates from Gilbert, Arizona, where it was founded on April 5, 2008, by Jason Hertel. The company is family-owned and operated, born from Hertel’s observation that many restaurants and delis were overpaying for subpar repair work. He set out to provide honest, high-quality service at reasonable rates, guided by the principle that the company succeeds only when its customers succeed.

The business specializes in repair and preventive maintenance for a wide range of commercial food-preparation and cooking equipment. Technicians service all makes and models of meat slicers, vegetable cutters, mixers, meat choppers, grinders, bread and bagel slicers, vegetable choppers, warmers, and Amana commercial microwaves. They also serve as the Arizona authorized service location for several equipment brands and are the designated home of the EZPRO 120 ventless deep fryer for restaurants and concessions. Work is performed both on-site via mobile service and in the company’s shop, with after-hours and weekend availability.

Precision Food Equipment serves the foodservice industry across Arizona and, through the EZPRO line, nationally. Its customer base includes multi-unit chains such as Arby’s, Wildflower Bread Company, Claim Jumper, and YC’s Mongolian Grill, along with numerous independent restaurants, delis, and concession operators. Customized preventive-maintenance plans address safety, staff training, food-waste reduction, production consistency, and downtime prevention.

The company differentiates itself by routing every service call directly to a factory-trained technician, promising same-day or next-day response, and backing all work with a satisfaction guarantee. Hertel’s original commitment to transparent pricing and honest diagnostics remains the operational standard.
